# Original regression fixtures

`polyphony.mid` is a small study authored for this project under its GPL licence.
It has a conductor track (4/4, C, 500,000 then 600,000 microseconds per quarter)
and a note track: C4/E4 at tick 0, C4 released and G4 attacked at tick 480, then
E4/G4 released at tick 960. Sustain goes down at 480 and up at 960. E4 uses a
zero-velocity note-on for its release. Resolution is 480 ticks per quarter;
the complete timeline lasts 1.1 seconds. It is not an excerpt of a published work.
